what: 9->6 layers, FINE-TUNED (13611 steps, lr 1e-4, 1 epoch, seed 0)
verdict: 9->7 is the optimum. 9->6 still helps cross-modal (+1.72 inliers) but HPatches starts to give way (-1.93 inliers, mAA -0.0096) - the first real accuracy loss of the three points. Recommend 9->7: 9->6 removes another 1.32 M parameters (14% of what remains) to buy -0.02 HPatches mAA and no cross-modal gain.
note_on_the_published_9_to_7: The 9->7 run was checked for the token_confidence length bug and is clean (framework builds 7/7/6 and the checkpoint holds 7/7/6, 9.897516 M both, zero unexpected tensors). The bug was latent at depth 7 because the framework itself builds n-1 token_confidence heads, so the surplus tensor coincides.
